decks.notes: The key concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy using low-cost creatures in the Weenie White archetype. By quickly building a board presence with cards like Adeline, Resplendent Cathar and Thalia's Lieutenant, and protecting them with Brave the Elements, the aim is to maintain pressure and force the opponent to react defensively. With a focus on early aggression and synergy between cards like Luminarch Aspirant and Thalia, Guardian of Thraben, this deck seeks to establish dominance and secure victory before the opponent can stabilize.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with spells to bring back Arclight Phoenix and trigger its ability multiple times in a turn. It includes a mix of cheap spells for efficiency and card draw to dig deeper into the deck. The deck also utilizes Thing in the Ice to control the board and provide additional threats. The mana base is designed to support a fast and consistent game plan, with options for additional power in the late game with the inclusion of Crackling Drake and Temporal Trespass.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with cards like Rotting Regisaur and Satyr Wayfinder to enable powerful combo plays with Greasefang and Parhelion II. By utilizing cards like Grisly Salvage and Witherbloom Command to fill the graveyard, the deck can set up explosive turns where it can generate multiple token copies of Parhelion II with Esika's Chariot. Thoughtseize and Collective Brutality help disrupt the opponent's game plan, while cards like Can't Stay Away provide additional graveyard recursion and value. The mana base supports the deck's color requirements while also including utility lands like Boseiju, Who Endures for protection.

This deck focuses on powerful aggressive creatures and disruption spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. It aims to apply early pressure with creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Kroxa, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize. The deck also utilizes powerful planeswalkers like Liliana of the Veil to control the board and generate card advantage. The mana base is designed to support the aggressive strategy, with a mix of fast lands and creature lands to ensure consistent mana development.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of aggressive Elves, utilizing cards like Collected Company to quickly flood the board with creatures. With a focus on generating mana through cards like Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx and Llanowar Elves, this deck aims to curve out efficiently and build a powerful board presence. Cards like Shaman of the Pack and Steel Leaf Champion provide additional damage and finishers, while Realmwalker and Circle of Dreams Druid offer card advantage and ramp. The deck aims to win quickly through relentless aggression and efficient mana production.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures like Kroxa and Bonecrusher Giant to apply early pressure on opponents. It also includes disruptive cards like Thoughtseize and Liliana of the Veil to control the game and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also includes some removal spells like Fatal Push and Dreadbore to deal with threats on the opponent's side of the board. Overall, the deck aims to be proactive and establish board presence quickly while disrupting the opponent's strategy.

The main focus of this Azorius Tempo/Spirit Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy utilizing flying creatures such as Spectral Sailor, Shacklegeist, and Supreme Phantom. By utilizing cards like Rattlechains and Mausoleum Wanderer to protect your creatures and disrupt your opponent's game plan, you can chip away at their life total quickly. Curious Obsession helps you draw cards and maintain card advantage, while cards like Geistlight Snare and Slip Out the Back provide additional control options. Otawara, Soaring City and Faceless Haven provide backup win conditions for when your creatures are dealt with.

The main focus of this deck is to establish control over the game by utilizing counterspells and removal spells to disrupt the opponent's strategy. Cards like Absorb, Dovin's Veto, and Censor help to prevent key spells from resolving, while Portable Hole, March of Otherworldly Light, and Fateful Absence deal with opposing threats. The deck also includes powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Narset, Parter of Veils to generate card advantage and provide additional control options. The mana base is designed to support the deck's requirements and ensure consistent color access.

The deck focuses on quickly ramping up with mana dorks and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx to cast powerful green devotion cards like Old-Growth Troll and Cavalier of Thorns. Storm the Festival helps to find key creatures and planeswalkers, while also triggering devotion. The deck also includes support cards like Wolfwillow Haven and Oath of Nissa to further enhance mana production and card selection. The inclusion of Karn, the Great Creator allows for grabbing specific artifacts from the sideboard as needed for additional utility.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with instants and sorceries while also clearing the way for aggressive attacks with Arclight Phoenix. The deck includes a lot of card draw and filtering to help find the Phoenix and graveyard-filling spells. Fires of Victory is included to give the deck an extra boost in the late game, while Hall of Storm Giants can provide a powerful finisher. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast, evasive creatures and efficient removal spells.

The deck focuses on aggressive plays by utilizing a combination of creature threats and removal spells in the Rakdos color combination. The key strategy is to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push while applying pressure with efficient creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger. The deck aims to control the board with removal spells like Dreadbore and finish the game quickly with damage from its creatures. Additionally, the inclusion of powerful planeswalkers like Liliana of the Veil adds another dimension to the deck's strategy.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressively attacking the opponent and disrupting their strategy. By utilizing powerful creatures like Kroxa and Kalitas, along with removal spells like Fatal Push and Dreadbore, the deck aims to control the battlefield and pressure the opponent. Additionally, the deck includes cards that disrupt the opponent's hand, like Thoughtseize, and provide consistent card advantage, like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker. The mana base is optimized to ensure a smooth mana curve and consistent access to the necessary colors for spells and abilities.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming opponents with aggressive creatures and removal spells. It utilizes cards like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger, Bonecrusher Giant, and Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's game plan while applying constant pressure. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to secure victories. With a mix of efficient threats and disruptive spells, this deck aims to control the battlefield and close out games before the opponent can recover.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature plays combined with disruptive spells and powerful planeswalkers to control the board and pressure the opponent. The deck utilizes cards like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Bonecrusher Giant for early pressure, alongside removal spells like Fatal Push and Dreadbore to clear the way for attacks. Liliana of the Veil provides additional disruption, while Fable of the Mirror-Breaker can generate advantage. With a mix of threats and answers, this deck aims to win the game quickly through aggression and disruption.

This UW Control deck focuses on controlling the game through counterspells, removal spells, and card draw. The goal is to stall the game until key threats can be dealt with, while generating card advantage with cards like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Shark Typhoon. The deck also utilizes lands that provide additional utility, such as Field of Ruin for removing problematic lands and Castle Ardenvale for generating creature tokens. With a mix of permission spells and versatile threats, this deck aims to outvalue and outlast opponents in a longer game.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy using low-cost creatures with powerful abilities and synergies, supported by protection spells and combat tricks. By utilizing cards like Thalia's Lieutenant and Luminarch Aspirant to grow your board quickly, as well as Brave the Elements to protect your creatures from removal, the goal is to maintain a strong presence on the battlefield and pressure the opponent before they have a chance to stabilize. The aggressive nature of this Weenie White deck aims to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent to secure a swift victory.
